report_uuid.description: A unique identifier for the report.

download_report_request_url.description: URL to download the report. Make a GET request to this URL to get the s3 download link. This field is empty for NO_DATA or ERROR status.

report_status.description: Status of the report. Possible values are COMPLETE, ERROR, or NO_DATA.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the report status. This field is empty for COMPLETE status.
